cohort: 526 neonates admitted to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, Islamabad, Pakistan from January 2013 to December 2013, of which 376 (71.48%) underwent surgery.
finding: The overall postoperative survival was 59.04%, with most deaths occurring between postoperative days 3 and 5 due to sepsis, hypothermia, and electrolyte imbalance.
followup_time: Variable, up to time of death or discharge, with most deaths occurring between postoperative days 3 to 5
birth_weight: low birth weight (mentioned as a contributor to mortality but no specific range provided)
